Fangol and Spirit Blade.how_to_obtain: Turn in Djinni War Blade (7-SotS), Gem of Invigoration (7-Trash) plus Wind Rune Jaka to Test NPC to complete 'Warrior Test of Smash' (reward: Fangol, Spirit Blade).

Belt of the Four Winds.how_to_obtain: Turn in Fine Belt Buckle plus Wind Rune Beza to Test NPC to complete 'Warrior Test of Belts' (reward: Belt of the Four Winds).
